title: Whispers from the Liminal — ep. 21 · visitation

nodes.text: WHISPERS FROM THE LIMINAL · ep. 21 · visitation
This one came in as a voicemail. No number. A man, calm, the kind of calm you get after.
I asked the listeners if anyone knew the voice. Nine of you wrote back. Nine different names.
“I wake up having spent the day with my family. My love and children, lost to me upon waking. What sort of condition is this, to rise staggered and heartbroken.”
“Figure, ten times a year upon average. Lost, for a moment, gut wrenched for the day’s remainder.”
“Visitation never a certainty. A week, a day, this month as forward continuum. Skipping along for how long now.”
“If I give you a date, I’m thrice damned.”
The message runs on after he stops talking. Rain on a window. A girl’s voice, far off, asking if he’s coming back in.
He never gave a date. The voicemail did. It’s stamped a Tuesday that hasn’t happened yet.
